What you need to know about birthday deals & freebies in Singapore

“Singapore where got free one,” is probably a thought running through your head now, and rightly so. All freebies do come with a catch, but some are as good as it gets, especially when all you need to do is sign up for a membership or download an app. Others require a minimum spend, so while not free per se, you’re still getting your money’s worth through discounts or vouchers.

The majority of freebies are food and drinks, but you might also score some cool products and services. They can be redeemed during your birthday month, though some might only be redeemable a few days before, after, or on your birthday itself. Don’t worry – we’ve got all the details covered to make sure you know exactly when to claim them.

1. Beauty in The Pot

Free slice of cake


Image credit: @obliquez via Instagram

Hotpot birthday celebrations are common, but you can make yours extra special by indicating your birthday at Beauty in The Pot to get a free slice of cake. They’ve been known to give rainbow stacked cakes or chocolate cakes in cute shapes like teddy bears. Just ensure that you make an online reservation and inform the staff in advance.

Find out more about Beauty in The Pot’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Day of dining in.

Full list of Beauty in The Pot outlets.

2. Boost Juice

Free original-sized drink of any kind


Image credit: Boost Juice Bars Singapore

If your birthday resolution is to be healthier, it can start with a free drink from Boost. Just download the Boost Juice Singapore app (App Store | Google Play) and register for their Vibe card, FOC.

Do note that you’ll have to accrue at least 1 VIBE point by buying a single drink before you can redeem your free birthday drink. Additionally, once you hit 10 points, you can redeem another free drink.

Find out more about Boost Juice’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Up to 14 days before or after birthday.

Full list of Boost Juice locations.

3. Haidilao

Free fruit platter & cake with a birthday song

At this point, you’re probably aware of most of the Haidilao freebies, but here’s a reminder. Finish off a lovely birthday evening with Haidilao’s enormous complimentary birthday fruit platter. The spread consists of kiwi, seedless grapes, dragon fruit, and mangoes. If it’s for your grandparents, they’ll be treated to extra longevity buns for health and a long life.

You’ll also be treated to a slice of cake plus a song from the staff. The best thing is, you don’t even need a membership, but do let them know in advance that it’s your birthday, so it’s easier for them to prepare. It’ll come with a whole birthday “performance”, but if the INFP within is screaming, you can ask the staff to do away with the whole song and dance.

Redeem on: Day of dining in.

Full list of Haidilao outlets.

4. Mr. Coconut

Free drink or dessert


Image credit: @jurongpoint via Instagram

Members of Mr. Coconut are entitled to either a free drink, ice cream, or yoghurt on their birthday, giving you many options to choose from. All you have to do is sign up for a free membership with Mr Coconut to get a cool treat to mark your birthday.

And if you’re a Super Coconut tier member, you’ll be able to receive 2 items of your choice during your birthday month.

Find out more about Mr Coconut’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Within birthday month.

Full list of Mr. Coconut outlets.

5. McDonald’s

Free 20-piece McNuggets with $12 spent


Image credit: @dundundailies via Instagram

Singaporeans seem to be obsessed with McDonald’s, especially with the number of 24/7 McDonald’s outlets around. You’ll be glad to know that you can get a 20-piece McNuggets box for free during your birthday month. Just ensure you have downloaded the McDonald’s app (App Store | Google Play), then spend a minimum of $12 to qualify for this promotion.

Find out more about McDonald’s birthday freebie.

Redeem on: Within birthday month.

Full list of McDonald’s outlets.

6. Suki-Ya

Free buffet with 3 paying adults


Image credit: @george.kooi via Instagram

Feast like a king on your birthday with a free regular buffet at Suki-Ya. Bring along friends and family as this birthday freebie is only redeemable with at least 3 other adults paying for the buffet (U.P. from $23.90/pax). You don’t even need a membership, and it’s available at all their outlets islandwide, so just find the closest one to you.

Find out more about Suki-Ya’s birthday month promotion.

Redeem on: Within birthday month, on Mon-Thu, except PH and PH eve.

Full list of Suki-Ya outlets.

9. Ikkousha Hakata Ramen

Free gyozas based on your age


Image for illustrative purposes only.
Image credit: @george.kooi via Instagram 

The older you are, the more free gyozas you can redeem at Ikkousha Hakata Ramen. Basically, you get a platter of gyozas according to your age. So if you’re 25 years old, you get 25 free gyozas. There’s no capped limit for this, so rest assured, your 65-year-old grandpa can redeem 65 gyozas for the fam.

Here’s the catch: you need to ensure that you have at least 4 people dining, and each person has to order at least 1 bowl of ramen.

Find out more about the Ikkousha Ramen’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: 1 day before or after birthday.

10. Cajun on Wheels

Free lobster after ordering the Olympian Bucket


Image credit: Cajun on Wheels

Redeem a free lobster when you purchase an Olympian bucket set (U.P. $254) at Cajun on Wheels, which can easily feed a group of 6. No membership is required, but ensure you book the table in advance and indicate “birthday lobster” so they can prepare it for you. Don’t try to cheat cause they will ask for a valid photo ID of the birthday girl/boy.

Find out more about the Cajun on Wheels birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Within birthday month.

15. Lawry’s The Prime Rib

Free dessert, instant photo & 3rd main course


Image credit: @lawryssg via Instagram 

Have an atas meal without paying a fortune at Lawry’s The Prime Rib. Join as a Lawry’s Privilege Circle Member for free, and you’ll get a free dessert, an instant photo print, and a 2nd main course at 50% off. If the group consists of more than just 2 of you, get the 3rd main course free of charge. Do note that they will ask for your ID for verification.

Find out more about Lawry’s The Prime birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Birthday month, except December, PH, and PH eve, including New Year’s Day, Valentine’s Day, Easter Day, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, F1 Grand Prix, Thanksgiving, and 21st-31st December.

19. Spizza

Free $20 voucher


Image credit: @spizzasg via Instagram

Comfort food is synonymous with pizza, and at Spizza, you can soften the blow to your wallet while still enjoying yourself with their free $20 voucher. Just sign up for their Spizza for Friends programme or download the Spizza App (App Store | Google Play) and spend a minimum of $40, and you’re good to go.

Just note that it excludes the cost of GST and delivery fees, but you can avoid that by dining in or going for the takeaway option.

Find out more about Spizza’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Within 30 days of birthday month.

20. Plain Vanilla

Free slice of cake


Image credit: @singaporedealsandfreebies via Instagram

To enjoy a free slice of cake from Plain Vanilla, all you need is to have completed at least one prior transaction. Remember to join their PV rewards club beforehand, and you will receive the birthday reward on the first day of your birthday month in your account.

Find out more about Plain Vanilla’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Within 31 days of birthday month.

Full list of Plain Vanilla outlets.

24. Gelatissimo

Free single scoop of gelato


Image credit: @gelatissimosg via Instagram

This year, head to Gelatissimo for a free single scoop on your birthday. You’ll need to first sign up for the Club Gelato App (App Store | Google Play) and have made a purchase of at least $5 over the past year. Remember to download the app to see updates on the birthday rewards and other exclusive offers.

Find out more about Gelatissimo’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: On birthday.

Full list of Gelatissimo outlets.

25. Jumbo Seafood

$100 birthday voucher with min. $200 spent


Image credit: Lorna Foo via Google Maps

If you want to celebrate your birthday with seafood, but don’t want to pay too much, celebrate it at Jumbo Seafood. Sign up as a Jumbo Rewards member, and you’ll receive a $100 voucher to Jumbo Seafood, a $100 voucher to Zui Teochew Cuisine, and a $20 to Ng Ah Sio Bak Kut Teh 14 days before your birthday. These can only be used with a minimum spend of $200, $200, and $40 respectively.

Don’t sign up too late, as new members who sign up within the 2 weeks before their birthdays will not be eligible for this promotion. Do note that there is a $20 fee for new membership sign-ups.

Find out more about the Jumbo Seafood birthday voucher.

Redeem on: 14 days before & after birthday.

Full list of Jumbo Seafood outlets.

29. Uniqlo

Free $7 voucher for your next $70 online or in-store order

Image credit: Uniqlo Singapore Facebook

You say birthday, we say voucher. Sign up for a free UNIQLO account or download the UNIQLO app (App Store | Google Play), and when you spend a minimum of $70, you’ll get a $7 voucher to offset your UNIQLO shopping. It’s time to get the iconic Uniqlo oversized T-shirts, affectionately dubbed the “national uniform” of Singaporean guys.

Find out more about UNIQLO’s birthday promotion.

Redeem on: Within birthday month.
